worked_solution:
We proceed to factor the left-hand side by grouping:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{3}+7{x}^{2}-3x-21 & = \\ ({x}^{3}+7{x}^{2})-(3x+21) & = \\ {x}^{2}(x+7)-3(x+7) & = \\ (x+7)\cdot {x}^{2}-(x+7)\cdot 3 & = \\ (x+7)({x}^{2}-3) & .\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we solve $(x+7)({x}^{2}-3)=0$ by setting each factor equal to $0.$

- Setting the factor $(x+7)$ equal to $0,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}x+7 & =0 \\ x & =-7.\end{aligned}
$$

- Setting the factor $({x}^{2}-3)$ equal to $0,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}-3 & =0 \\ {x}^{2} & =3 \\ x & =\pm \sqrt{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solutions are $x=-7,\,\pm \sqrt{3}.$
